//Secrets: Never commit real values here. Use user-secrets for local development: dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:Secret" "<32+ random chars>" --project src/HousingHub.API
//Cors: Localhost origins live here rather than in the shared appsettings.json, so they never reach production.

Dynamo.//AutoCreateTables: Local development: create any missing tables at startup so a fresh DynamoDB Local works out of the box.
Dynamo.//UsePublishedIndex: Reads published listings from PublishedStatus-index instead of scanning Properties. MUST stay false until every published row has been re-saved so it appears in the sparse index - see docs/data-backfill-required.md. Switching this on early empties the homepage.

//Sentry: Dsn empty = monitoring off, app unaffected. Set it per environment (AWS Lambda env var Sentry__Dsn). Use a DIFFERENT Sentry project for each API.
//Verification: ShowTitleBadge governs whether a title-verified listing displays the 'Title Verified' badge to renters. Leave false until a lawyer has signed off on the wording - it is the strongest claim the platform makes and the first thing a defrauded buyer's lawyer will point at. Verification still runs and is recorded either way.
